title: A skill is a recipe, not a law.
hook: A skill is a recipe. It is not a law, and confusing the two breaks systems.
thesis: In TenantOS, skills are procedural knowledge: how to do a task. They are explicitly not truth, not preference, and not authorization, and no skill gets to rewrite the constitution it was given. Short, punchy, and quotable: a boundary every agent builder should draw.

verified: Skills are procedural knowledge that is explicitly not truth, not preference, not authorization (TENANTOS-HARVEST-ORDER.md, via SYSTEMS.md section 3).

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
